g.text: Quartet disagreement: resolution changes versus conflicts
Supported tree differences can change resolution without opposing strong clades
All original taxa retained; joint SH-aLRT ≥80 and UFBoot ≥95; original edges ≤1e−6 collapsed before comparison.
Exact: ghy3 5,985 quartets. Other inputs: 10,000 fixed-seed uniform draws with replacement.
10 selected comparisons nested within 5 input hashes; neither quartet draws nor comparisons are biological replicates.
Unshown quartets have matching resolutions. Support and disagreement are conditional on each alignment/model, not biological accuracy.
